scope: MEAS: re-review of the round-3 republication (Patrizia Prati), score SHA-256 fac2ebf0…. Covers the four bar-58/59 constraints, the author's q115.5/q116 correction to my round-2 fix, the listed residual, hashes, gates and the sheet pack. Audio checks: fresh-CQT reviewer overlays over 190–202 and 193–199.2 s, pitch bands, fine onsets, a per-bar lag scan, and audio-to-audio DTW. Not aural review.

- A-sharp6–F-sharp6–C-sharp6: 196.835/196.996/197.140 s against 196.97/197.06/197.20 s.
- Bar 59 (q116.5): 197.280 s against G-sharp6 197.34 s and F-sharp2 197.36 s.

In the zoomed reviewer overlay every long note and triplet starts on its measured energy, and the bar-59 line sits at the F-sharp2 onset. The lag scan no longer favours a shift for bar 58 or 59 (gains of 0.006 and 0.012).

observations.finding: The author is right. In the encoding, bar 58 starts at q114.5. B6 with C-sharp3/F-sharp3/A-sharp3 is at +3/2 = q116. q115.5 (+1) is the left-hand F-sharp3/A-sharp3/C-sharp4 chord with no upper note. My round-2 fix named the right audio window, [196.1, 196.25] s for B6, but the wrong scoreQ. The author's q115.5 constraint at 195.08 s and the unconstrained q116 at 196.16 s both match the measured onsets above.

Non-blocking; this is the author's listed residual, confirmed. The two repeated C-sharp3/A-sharp3 triplet notes q115.167/q115.333 are at 194.521/194.809 s, against flux onsets at 194.32 and 194.64 s and A-sharp3 rises at 194.63 and 194.92 s. That is 0.17–0.2 s late, or within 0.1 s if the 194.63/194.92 rises are the attacks; the measurement is ambiguous. These are inner left-hand notes inside bar 58, so bar lighting is unaffected.

Documentation only. DTW from Faulkner still differs at bar 59 (+3.52 s) and bar 61 (−1.05 s), and Prati-to-Paderewski differs at bar 59 (−1.77 s). Prati's bar 59 (197.28 s; F-sharp2 197.36 s) and bar 61 (206.05 s; F-sharp2 206.04 s) are band-confirmed. Faulkner's bars 59 and 61 are band-confirmed too, so the chroma DTW fails over these repeated arpeggio figures.

report.finding: The four new constraints (193.90, 195.08, 197.28 and 198.00 s), the gates and score SHA-256 fac2ebf0… match the receipt and the public file. The candidate equals the public file; results equal checks; the config and audio hashes match.

barMap.finding: All 1,326 notes lie inside their bar, and bar times increase. check_contract.py prints 'ok'. The sheet pages, with DOM ids stripped, equal the inspected round-2 pages and the sibling packs, and index.json is byte-identical. The inventory is matched, with 1 token correction.

independentChecks.lagScan: Zero-lag cosine is 0.767. 58 of 63 bars fit best within 0.3 s. The exceptions are bars 44 and 45 (repeated D-natural figure), bars 58 and 59 (gain at most 0.012) and bar 62 (held chord).
independentChecks.carriedForward: The round-2 checks of the opening, bars 24–26 (constrained at 104.10/106.48 s), the bar-48/49 join, bars 60–62 and the bar-61 pitch correction still apply.

overlays.finding: Bars 57–60 land on the measured music. The two late left-hand repeats in bar 58 are the only visible offsets.
